title: Why give thoughts a place?
claim: Data Mountain's study found that its spatial document workspace supported spatial memory and outperformed Internet Explorer Favorites for managing documents.
sourceTitle: Data Mountain: Using Spatial Memory for Document Management
support: The authors' abstract reports a user study, spatial-memory use, and statistically reliable advantages over Internet Explorer Favorites.
limitation: This studied a different document workspace. It does not establish a memory benefit, placement accuracy, or speed advantage for E2A2O.
connection: E2A2O lets you place thoughts and threads on its Canvas. Try the Canvas, then return to the same point in your demonstration.
